milestones.outcome: Attended-review sessions can publish private, ordered summaries to a configured hub while preserving local review behavior when delivery is unavailable.
exit_criteria: The publisher meets the record, configuration, lifecycle and failure-isolation contract against disposable fixtures; the integrated contract revision is ready for the standalone service handoff.
milestones.boundary: A verified optional AgentSkills publisher and versioned record contract, usable before a real hub exists; no publication or consumer upgrade is implied.

milestones.outcome: Every attended-review session on a configured machine publishes to the owner's hub without per-session flags, from any harness or shell, while explicit session choices keep precedence.
exit_criteria: RFC-ASK-0018 AC08 passes against disposable config paths and fixture hubs; AC01-AC07 still pass, and a missing machine file keeps the never-enabled invariants.
milestones.boundary: Owner amendment 2026-11-04: per-user machine default file and a hub-config helper; no real user config, consumer upgrade, push or hub deployment.
